thread:
maria: quick idea — can we add a tiny 'microview' on route rows that shows routing policy + quota burn + sampling preview? Would help quick triage without opening the whole inspector
aj: +1. want to see routing tier, active fallback, and recent sample rate. Could live as a hover or expand panel.
sam: concern: previewing sampling data might accidentally trigger extra telemetry reads/costs. need a safe way to show a representative sample, not full query. :money_with_wings:
trina: agreed with sam. We could generate a sampling preview client-side from stored aggregated stats instead of replaying traces. basically: show "estimated sample" numbers and a tiny time-series sparkline.
maria: UX thought — add two small affordances: (1) link to saved query used for telemetry preview, (2) small toggle "live preview" (off by default) that fetches a bounded sample when on.
aj: from API side we could add an endpoint: `GET /api/routes/:id/insights/microview?live=false&limit=50` that returns config + aggregated telemetry. Example response: ````json
{
  "route_id":"rt-12ab",
  "routing_policy":"latency-first",
  "quota":{ "limit_per_min":6000, "used_last_min":420 },
  "sampling_rate":0.02,
  "saved_query":"sq-202",
  "estimated_samples": [ {"t":"2026-03-20T10:00Z","count":2}, {"t":"2026-03-20T10:01Z","count":3} ]
}
````
sam: that shape is fine. keep `sampling_rate` as a float. but what about route variants? some routes have model-level overrides and dedupe. need `overrides` list or we show the effective rate and a note that overrides exist.
trina: i think show `effective_sampling` + `overrides_summary` (short string). we should avoid long nested payloads in the microview API — keep it compact for fast fetch.
aj: agree. microview should be <= 8kb. No heavy arrays. `estimated_samples` should be precomputed top-3 buckets.
maria: UX: when a saved query is attached show a little preview pill that opens query editor on click. If saved query is missing show "no telemetry query attached" and a CTA to attach.
sam: rollout concern — adding another backend endpoint means we need to version it carefully. maybe make it part of `routes.v2` contract and gate behind feature flag `microview_insights`. ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered a canary deploy for feature/microview at 1769995450 :robot_face:
ops-bot: Canary deployment success on infra-canary-05 (20% traffic). Logs: `canary:microview started`
aj: good call on flag. Also need to think about auth: microview can leak quota info. Should obey tenancy + role-based visibility.
trina: telemetry note — sampling preview should respect sample-probabilities AND redact user identifiers (PII). Crypto-team asked earlier to remove raw ids from these payloads.
maria: design constraint: keep the microview interaction < 200ms on the console. If `live=true` show a spinner and fetch but default to cached aggregates. 
aj: implementation plan: (1) API contract (compact payload), (2) server-side aggregator to precompute 1m/5m buckets, (3) console component, (4) feature flag & rollout. I'll post a draft OpenAPI snippet in #eng-platform.
sam: add a cost budget check on the backend call — if estimated cost > X, return `preview_unavailable_reason` so UI can show hint.
trina: also signal when sampling config differs between route and pinned model: `sampling_diff: "route=2% model=5%"`. small text is enough.
maria: ok let's converge: I'll mock a microview UI in Figma, aj please add the API draft, sam and trina please confirm the security + telemetry constraints. We'll pair on the canary results tomorrow. :raised_hands:
aj: ack, will drop API PR by EOD and put the feature flag in our rollout matrix.
sam: ack. and I'll write the telemetry cost guard as a policy in the API handler.
ops-bot: feature flag `microview_insights` toggled ON for org:internal-beta at 1769995480
maria: thanks all — small follow-ups in thread.
